blocks.text: The delegates of this year’s Miss Asia Pacific International pageant are in for a treat, as they are set to explore Cebu’s tourist destinations from north to south in a span of three weeks. Many of the participants are visiting the Philippines for the first time. On Sept. 28, the ladies will go island hopping, then explore the city the next day on Sept. 29. They will head north for a two-day tour on Sept. 30 to Oct. 1. The candidates will then head to the southern part of the province for a two-day tour on Oct. 3 to 4 before returning […]...
